name: Misty
source:
A mysterious warrior who is always seen wearing goggles. While she normally acts like a goofy elder sister, as a warrior she will successfully pass through various violent fight scenes. Furthermore, she will give the protagonist advices and prepare him to the fight against [url=/c1395]Yuu[/url].
What exactly is her goal?
